preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 3 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n for a, b, c in pieces)
preconditions.description: Each vertex number in the triangular pieces must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output permutation p must contain n distinct vertex numbers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: len(q) == n - 2 and all(1 <= q[i] <= n - 2 for i in range(n - 2))
postconditions.description: The output permutation q must contain n-2 distinct piece indices from 1 to n-2.

postconditions.expression: all(any(p[i] in piece for i in range(n)) for piece in pieces)
postconditions.description: Each triangular piece must correspond to vertices in the output permutation p.
